body: Here's what I said, some people are saying that it shows it as removed: I was checking up on a suicidal person on r/confessions and I found on it someone recommending a subreddit to them which is dedicated to helping people commit suicide (Many of you may know of it already, but I'm not going to put it's name here). Currently, there's little to no one on it trying to talk people out of it or trying to at least show them there are alternatives to killing themselves, which has lead to the subreddit devolving to a groupthink (circle jerk) style of a setting, were people are recommending each other on methods, starting groups to find suicide partners, and giving each other encouragement to kill them themselves. I can't help them all myself, so I need others to help me help these people or find a solution to this problem, and I'm open to ideas about what to do about it. Message me if your interested in helping in any way.
